error_page_unreadable: Leli khasi alikwazi ukufundwa. Amakhasi esiphequluli, i-Chrome Web Store kanye nama-PDF awasekelwa.
error_no_content: Awukho umbhalo we-athikili otholakele kuleli khasi.
error_needs_click: Chofoza isithonjana sesandiso ukuze ufinyeze leli khasi. Ngemva kokuba ithebhu iye kwelinye ikhasi, isandiso sidinga ukuchofoza okusha ukuze silifunde.
error_host_missing: Ingxenye yasendaweni ayifakiwe noma ayiphenduli. Kufolda yesandiso, qalisa: ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_missing: I-Claude Code ayitholakalanga. Yifake, bese uqalisa futhi ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_auth: Awungenile ku-Claude Code. Qalisa claude kutheminali bese ungena.
error_codex_signed_out: Awungenile ku-Codex. Qalisa codex login kutheminali.
error_codex_not_eligible: Uhlelo lwakho lwe-ChatGPT alukwazi ukusetshenziselwa lokhu. Khetha omunye umhlinzeki.
error_usage_limit: Usufinyelele umkhawulo wokusebenzisa wohlelo lwakho. Zama futhi kamuva noma ukhethe omunye umhlinzeki.
error_provider_failed: Umhlinzeki wehlulekile ngesikhathi ebhala isifinyezo. Zama futhi.
error_codex_missing: I-Codex ayitholakalanga. Yifake, bese uqalisa futhi ./native-host/install.sh
options_help: Izifinyezo zidlula engxenyeni yasendaweni kule khompyutha: iqalisa i-Claude Code noma i-Codex ngokubhalisa kwakho, noma imodeli ku-Ollama. Umbhalo wekhasi uthunyelwa kuphela kumhlinzeki omkhethayo.
error_ollama_missing: I-Ollama ayisebenzi kule khompyutha. Yifake usuka ku-ollama.com bese uyivula, bese uzama futhi.
error_ollama_model_missing: Le modeli ayikadawunilodwa ku-Ollama. Qalisa ollama pull negama lemodeli (isibonelo, ollama pull llama3.2), bese uzama futhi.
options_models_auto: Luvela ku-Claude Code, Codex no-Ollama, futhi lufundwa futhi kanye ngosuku, lapho i-Claude Code noma i-Codex ibuyekezwa, nalapho isandiso sibuyekezwa.
